environment.description: Same EKS pod in private subnet. S3 traffic routed exclusively through VPC endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3, Gateway type). VPC endpoint policy restricts PutObject to condition aws:sourceVpce matching vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f AND requires s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption header to be aws:kms with key arn:aws:kms::111122223333:key/mrk-9a8b7c6d. Route table has no NAT gateway route for S3 prefix list (pl-63a5400a removed from rtb). Pod security context has allowPrivilegeEscalation:false and drops NET_RAW capability. Network policy restricts egress to MSK broker ports (9092,9094) and S3 VPC endpoint prefix list only.

config.network_policy: Calico NetworkPolicy restricting egress to CIDR blocks for MSK brokers and S3 prefix list pl-63a5400a only, deny-all default
config.route_table: No 0.0.0.0/0 NAT route, only local VPC CIDR and S3 prefix list via vpce
